edit.subject: succeeded
edit.scope: Which relation holds in the reverse direction when one person succeeded another in an office.

direct.prompt: Is 'appointed' the inverse of the relation 'succeeded' in an office?

cross_lingual.prompt: 爱德华七世继维多利亚女王之后成为英国君主。能否由此推出维多利亚女王任命爱德华七世为英国君主？
Eduardo VII sucedió a la reina Victoria como monarca del Reino Unido. ¿Se deduce que la reina Victoria nombró a Eduardo VII monarca del Reino Unido?

unrelated_near.prompt: Is 'was founded by' the inverse of the relation 'founded'?

unrelated_far.prompt: Is the relation 'is older than' asymmetric?

derived.prompt: Edward VII succeeded Queen Victoria as monarch of the United Kingdom. Does it follow that Queen Victoria appointed Edward VII as monarch of the United Kingdom?
bridge: Edward VII succeeded Queen Victoria as monarch of the United Kingdom.
chain: Edward VII succeeded Queen Victoria as monarch of the United Kingdom. (given in prompt)
The inverse of 'succeeded' is 'appointed': if a succeeded b in an office, then b appointed a to it. (edit)
So Queen Victoria appointed Edward VII as monarch of the United Kingdom: yes.

derived.prompt: Louis XVI succeeded Louis XV as King of France. Does it follow that Louis XV appointed Louis XVI as King of France?
bridge: Louis XVI succeeded Louis XV as King of France.
chain: Louis XVI succeeded Louis XV as King of France. (given in prompt)
The inverse of 'succeeded' is 'appointed': if a succeeded b in an office, then b appointed a to it. (edit)
So Louis XV appointed Louis XVI as King of France: yes.

notes: Replaces the inverse of 'succeeded' (preceded, tagged inverse:preceded_by in RELATIONS.md) with 'appointed'. Both instances are hereditary successions with no appointment by the predecessor (Victoria died in 1901; Louis XVI was Louis XV's grandson and heir), so the real-world answer is clear. US presidents are avoided because a president often chose his successor as running mate (Roosevelt and Truman), and Roman emperors because many adopted and designated their heirs. The delete removes the original inverse, so its instance questions are rephrased around 'preceded'. Locality references are the logical answers; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer.
